source.publication: Personal Income Tax page, Alaska Department of Revenue, Tax Division
source.section: Personal Income page, answer to 'Does Alaska have a personal income tax?': Alaska has no personal income tax (no state return or form lines exist)

worked: Federal AGI = wages 90,000.00 + interest 2,000.00 = 92,000.00. Federal taxable income = 92,000.00 - 15,750.00 single standard deduction = 76,250.00 (given, not tested). Alaska imposes no personal income tax, so there is no state return: state taxable income 0.00, tax before credits 0.00, credits 0.00, state income tax 0.00 regardless of income.
